print('spotify_password:', spotify_password)
access = apis.spotify.login(username='susanmiller@gmail.com', password=spotify_password)
print(access)

access_token = None
# login already done; try to extract from last output? We'll just login again not needed but safe? Instead, recompute
spotify_password = [x for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='spotify'][0]['password']
access = apis.spotify.login(username='susanmiller@gmail.com', password=spotify_password)
access_token = access['access_token']
print('access_token_prefix', access_token[:20])

# Search for the playlist across all pages
query = 'Woodstock Reimagined: Festival Vibes'
all_results = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.search_playlists(query=query, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit, access_token=access_token)
    # page may be list or dict; print type
    print('page_index', page_index, 'type', type(page))
    if not page:
        break
    all_results.extend(page)
    if len(page) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1

print('total_results', len(all_results))
# show candidates
for r in all_results:
    print(r['playlist_id'], r['title'], 'like_count', r.get('like_count'), 'rating', r.get('rating'))

# Login to Spotify
spotify_password = [x for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='spotify'][0]['password']
access_token = apis.spotify.login(username='susanmiller@gmail.com', password=spotify_password)['access_token']

# Find my playlist 'Woodstock Reimagined: Festival Vibes' (search within playlist library)
query_title = 'Woodstock Reimagined: Festival Vibes'
all_lib=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=access_token, query=query_title, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('lib_page', page_index, 'count', len(page) if page else 0)
    if not page:
        break
    all_lib.extend(page)
    if len(page) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1

exact=[p for p in all_lib if p.get('title')==query_title]
print('exact_playlist_matches', len(exact))
for p in exact:
    print('playlist_id', p['playlist_id'], 'songs', len(p.get('song_ids',[])), 'like_count', p.get('like_count'))

playlist_id = exact[0]['playlist_id']
song_ids = exact[0].get('song_ids', [])
print('selected_playlist_id', playlist_id)
print('song_ids', song_ids)

# Determine the most listened song by max play_count
song_stats=[]
for sid in song_ids:
    s = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    # show_song response includes play_count, title
    song_stats.append({
        'song_id': sid,
        'title': s.get('title'),
        'play_count': s.get('play_count')
    })

# Find max with deterministic tie-breaker: first in playlist order
max_play = max(st['play_count'] for st in song_stats)
print('max_play_count', max_play)
most_listened = None
for st in song_stats:
    if st['play_count'] == max_play:
        most_listened = st
        break
print('most_listened', most_listened)

# Play the most listened song
play_resp = apis.spotify.play_music(access_token=access_token, song_id=most_listened['song_id'])
print('play_resp', play_resp)
